item.text: I’m using the imagegen skill to make the five head turns, using the side base for placement and the originals and photos for Odin’s likeness.
The centre draft is generated. I’m using it alongside the base for the remaining turns, with emphasis on a visible neck, anchored ruff, and separate white whiskers.
Both turns toward the viewer are generated. I’m now making the two turns away, including the back-of-head view and whiskers along the visible cheek.
The right profile is generated. The final turn will show more of the back of the head, with the far cheek and whiskers visible at the right edge.
